Noah (Eng): hey folks — quick heads up, i'm dealing with severe flare-ups from vestibular sensitivity when construction starts in the atrium. it's been causing nausea and balance issues after 2-3 hours in the space. can we set up a short-term accommodation? ideally: a private desk for the next 6 weeks, permission to reduce in-person meetings to critical ones only, and approval to switch my desk to a lower-traffic zone. happy to provide medical paperwork.

Priya (Manager): oh no, that's rough. thanks for telling us, @Noah. please take the rest of the afternoon if you need it. i'll cover your standups and i'll move any non-urgent onsite meetings off your calendar. @Camille / @Jorge can you advise on immediate steps?

Camille (People Ops): thanks for flagging this, Noah. you can submit via the accommodations portal but we can also do an interim fix now. immediate options: reserve a private room for focussed work, approve temporary remote days, and reimburse seat relocation costs up to $200. we will need a brief intake call (15m) to confirm needs and expected duration. is tomorrow 10:30am PT okay?

Noah (Eng): 10:30am works. i've uploaded a note from my clinician to the portal already. put 6 weeks as the expected timeframe but want a 3-week check-in.

Jorge (People Ops): noted. intake scheduled. manager sign-off will be collected after the call. policy reminder: to pause participation in calibration or peer feedback you need (1) employee request, (2) manager rationale, and (3) a review date. we can mark the record so calibration reviewers see the accommodation context.

Priya (Manager): i'll draft the manager rationale after the intake. for coverage: i'll reassign your pair-programming slots and ask Tess to cover code reviews while you're on reduced in-person.

OnsiteFacilitiesBot: Private room "Quiet-3" reserved for Noah on 2026-04-02 from 10:00 to 15:00 PT.

Noah (Eng): thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick help. i'll join the intake call and we can confirm the review cadence.

Camille (People Ops): follow-up: after intake we'll document the adjustments (desk relocation, meeting reductions, remote days), set a 3-week check-in, and log the reimbursement process. only the manager, People Ops, and Facilities will have access to case notes.
